query: Who won the 2025 Chilean presidential election?
answer: José Antonio Kast won the 2025 Chilean presidential election. He is the far-right leader of the Republican Party. In the runoff on December 14, 2025, he beat Jeannette Jara, the Communist candidate backed by the governing coalition, by about 58% (58.18%) to 42%, according to Chile's electoral authority, Servel [1][2][3]. Neither candidate reached the 50% needed in the first round on November 16, so the race went to a runoff [4]. Jara conceded, and outgoing President Gabriel Boric congratulated Kast. This was Kast's third run for president and his first win [2][3]. He took office on March 11, 2026, the date Chilean presidential terms normally begin.
